reach.sanAntonio: San Antonio's permit export has no description column at all, so there is nothing to fingerprint and no San Antonio series is covered. Its analogue is the permit-type mix — backlog item 36. Absence of a flag there is absence of a measurement, not absence of a break.
reach.detectsOnly: changes that TEMPLATE wording. A source that re-words diversely, renames a permit type or stops publishing a field leaves shape concentration untouched and will not be flagged.
reach.blindSpotMeasured: the same break can be visible in a SECOND category without being flagged there. Austin's Auxiliary Power EPs are also electrical permits, so the templated wording entered electrical too: 5.24× concentration in 2026-08 with diversity at 0.96× — declined, on purpose, because a rule loose enough to catch it also fires on roofing 2026-01 and 2026-06. Read a flag on one category as 'at least here', never as 'only here'.
reach.earliest: the first COMPLETE month after a change, which is the earliest anything can be under the completeness rule the readers already apply.
